integrity: Proof is given for all lengths; reproducible finite computation is corroborative, not a proof of an infinite statement. Historical source coverage is qualified where full text was inaccessible. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact instance-wise common-zero padding and extremal counts hold only for binary words with exactly two ones each; no claims for general Hamming weight or arbitrary alphabets. Unindexed priority coverage remains possible.
title: Exact common-zero insertion distance for binary words of weight two
